digest.lead: Claude Sonnet 4.6 experienced elevated error rates today, marking another service interruption for the platform.
digest.summary: Meanwhile, Claude Code received important Bedrock authentication fixes and new features including higher default effort levels and Amazon Bedrock Mantle support.

stories.headline: Claude Sonnet 4.6 Experiences Service Disruption
stories.summary: Claude Sonnet 4.6 encountered elevated error rates today [1], continuing a pattern of recent service interruptions [2]. The incident gained attention on Hacker News with users discussing the reliability issues.
key_points: Service disruption affected Claude Sonnet 4.6 model specifically
Recent pattern of service interruptions noted by community
stories.impact: Affects users relying on Claude Sonnet 4.6 for daily workflows, particularly those with time-sensitive tasks or production dependencies.

sources.title: Claude is having another moment, again

stories.headline: Claude Code Releases Critical Bedrock Auth Fix and New Features
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.96 fixed a regression causing Bedrock authorization failures [1], following v2.1.94 which introduced Amazon Bedrock Mantle support and raised default effort levels to 'high' for most users [2]. The updates also added enhanced Slack integration and plugin customization options.
key_points: Fixed critical Bedrock authentication bug affecting AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK users
Added Amazon Bedrock Mantle support via CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1 flag
Changed default effort level from medium to high for API-key, Bedrock, Team, and Enterprise users
stories.impact: Critical for developers using Claude Code with AWS Bedrock who experienced authentication failures, while the higher default effort level will improve output quality for most users.

stories.headline: Discussion Around Anthropic's Project Glasswing Gains Traction
stories.summary: Simon Willison's analysis of Anthropic's Project Glasswing sparked discussion on Hacker News, with the community engaging around the project's necessity and implications [1]. The post generated moderate engagement with focused discussion among participants.
stories.impact: Highlights community interest in Anthropic's broader research directions beyond core model development, particularly among AI researchers and developers following the company's strategic initiatives.

sources.title: Anthropic's Project Glasswing sounds necessary to me

stories.headline: Enable Amazon Bedrock support with Mantle integration
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.94 added support for Amazon Bedrock through Mantle integration. This allows you to use Claude Code with Amazon's Bedrock service instead of the default API endpoints, potentially offering better performance or compliance for enterprise users.
actionable_steps: Set the environment variable CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1 in your system or terminal
Restart Claude Code to apply the new configuration
Verify the connection is working by running a test query

stories.headline: Use defer permission in PreToolUse hooks to pause headless sessions
stories.summary: You can now pause headless Claude Code sessions at tool calls and resume them later with permission evaluation. This allows for better control over automated workflows that need human approval.
actionable_steps: Set up a PreToolUse hook in your Claude Code configuration
Return 'defer' as the permission decision in the hook
The hook will re-evaluate the tool call upon resumption

stories.headline: Write a CLAUDE.md file to set project conventions once
stories.summary: Adding a CLAUDE.md to your project root lets you define coding standards, test commands, and architectural decisions that persist across every Claude Code session. Think of it as onboarding documentation that Claude reads automatically — you teach it once instead of repeating yourself.
actionable_steps: Create a CLAUDE.md in your project root with build/test/lint commands
Add coding conventions like naming patterns, preferred libraries, and file structure
Include architectural decisions and constraints Claude should respect
Use /init in Claude Code to auto-generate a starter CLAUDE.md

stories.headline: Enable PowerShell tool for Windows development workflows
stories.summary: Claude Code now includes an opt-in PowerShell tool that allows Windows users to execute PowerShell commands directly through Claude. This provides native Windows command-line access for system administration and development tasks.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.84 or later
Enable the PowerShell tool in your settings as a preview feature

stories.headline: Use _meta annotation to prevent large MCP tool results from being truncated
stories.summary: Claude Code now supports preserving large tool results (like database schemas) up to 500K characters by adding a special metadata annotation. This prevents important data from being cut off during processing.
actionable_steps: Add `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` annotation to your MCP tool result
Set the value to your desired character limit (up to 500,000)
Test with large results like database schemas to verify they pass through completely
